vpn-profiles-and-a-dialog-stub: set_vpn_passwd.sh.erb:15-20 look for a listed connection's profile at /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/<name>; the setup writes VPN1/VPN3/VPN4 keyfiles at that path (VPN1 to the peer server with the throwaway CA, VPN4 in openvpn_nm_connection's shape) and the kdialog stub, and the effect reads NetworkManager's connection list and the stub, so the profiles exist both for the baseline file test and for local change #21's nmcli lookup
